# Detecteerbare effectgrootte {#sec-detecteerbare-effectgrootte}

```{r}
#| echo: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| message: FALSE
library(knitr)
library(targets)
library(tidyverse)

source("R/tar_read_mas.R")
```

```{r}
target_species <- c(
  "Geelgors",
  "Veldleeuwerik"
)
```

```{r}
# Get effect sizes
detectable_effect_df <- lapply(target_species, function(spec) {
  tar_read_mas("detectable_effect_df", species = spec)
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

detectable_effect_df <- detectable_effect_df %>%
  mutate(
    beta3 = detectable_effect,
    beta3_low = detectable_effect_low,
    beta3_high = detectable_effect_high,

    effect_pct = 100 * (exp(beta3) - 1),
    effect_pct_low = 100 * (exp(beta3_low) - 1),
    effect_pct_high = 100 * (exp(beta3_high) - 1)
  )
```


```{r}
detectable_effect_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n_telpunten, y = effect_pct, colour = species)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = effect_pct_low,
      ymax = effect_pct_high
    ),
    width = 5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Aantal telpunten",
    y = "Detecteerbare jaarlijkse interactieverandering (%)",
    colour = "Soort"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
detectable_effect_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sigma_punt, y = effect_pct,
             colour = factor(n_telpunten), group = factor(n_telpunten))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = effect_pct_low,
      ymax = effect_pct_high
    ),
    width = 0.1
  ) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = "y ~ x") +
  labs(
    x = "Variabiliteit telpunten (sigma_punt)",
    y = "Detecteerbare jaarlijkse interactieverandering (%)",
    colour = "Aantal telpunten"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
detectable_effect_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = exp(beta_0), y = effect_pct,
             colour = factor(n_telpunten), group = factor(n_telpunten))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = effect_pct_low,
      ymax = effect_pct_high
    ),
    width = 0.01
  ) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = "y ~ x") +
  labs(
    x = "Startdensiteit (exp(beta_0))",
    y = "Detecteerbare jaarlijkse interactieverandering (%)",
    colour = "Aantal telpunten"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
